study: Gradient-scale-matched objective ablation across four IQP architectures
scaling: For each fit, compute c = norm(gradient_parity(theta0)) / norm(gradient_objective(theta0)) from training observations and the common sampled masks. Hold c fixed for all 600 updates; parity c=1. Zero or nonfinite initial norms fail explicitly.
selection: For every radius and objective independently, choose the learning rate with minimum mean validation NLL on seeds111-120. Each receives the same six rates and 600 updates. Tie by configuration key. Exact KL never selects. Parity sigmas .75/1/1/1 are inherited from the prior architecture study; the fixed sigma also defines the reference gradient for every other loss.
confirmation_scope: Freeze all28 selected configurations, all120 new paired datasets and24 comparisons before any confirmation fit. All four architectures share datasets. Retain every final iterate; no early stopping, sample expansion, replacement seeds or retuning after inspecting this cohort. The earlier36-parameter cohort remains separate evidence.
inference: Primary metric: exact unfloored forward KL.24 two-sided paired t comparisons, parity minus each of six alternatives within each of four architectures. Report nominal95% intervals and Bonferroni intervals with alpha=.05/24 for approximate95% family coverage. Failed/nonfinite pairs invalidate a comparison; never omit seeds. The four architectures share datasets and are not480 independent observations.
claim_scope: n=12,beta=.9,m=200,600 updates, tested36/48/60/66-parameter ring circuits. A prospectively specified architecture extension after the original36-parameter analysis. Does not establish universal loss superiority, robustness across targets or sample sizes, or quantum computational advantage.
seed_note: Reserve920001-920120 before any runs. Derived training seeds920008-920127, mask seeds920223-920342, initialization seeds933585-933704 and validation seeds970001-970120. robustness: Before confirmation, define consistent average superiority as the lowest mean KL at every tested radius; statistically supported superiority at a radius requires all six adjusted intervals below zero. Report the count of passing radii and all24 comparisons. Separately report per-objective median, SD,90th/95th percentiles and maximum KL at each radius, with no significance claim for these descriptive stability measures. Good mean performance does not imply smallest spread or best tail.
